description: This PHP script initiates the save operation for an opportunity in SuiteCRM. It includes licensing and validation comments, loads the OpportunityFormBase class, creates an instance, and calls its handleSave method to process the save.

classes.name: OpportunityFormBase
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the opportunity form operations, specifically the save process.
